titleEn: Upgrade or switch a yearly package

en: I have a yearly plan and want to upgrade

steps: Move up: pay only the difference for remaining months, starts at once, same end date; lower/monthly starts after current ends, no refund
edgeCases: Queued period already paid: contact support (cannot change)
Refund of a yearly plan is operator-only
gaps: Yearly refund/cancel only by operator (see operator.yearly-refund)
